items.title: How Democrats reshaped the Senate, in charts and maps
items.brief: Two years after President Donald Trump carried much of the country’s political map, voters in some of his strongest states delivered a dramatic reversal Tuesday.

items.title: Missile strikes multi-story Aramco building in Riyadh’s financial district, witnesses say
items.brief: A building belonging to Saudi oil giant Aramco in the financial district in the capital Riyadh has been damaged in a missile attack.

items.title: As fresh peace talks loom, Putin is escalating his efforts to shatter Ukraine’s economy
items.brief: As Russia struggles to advance on the ground in eastern Ukraine, it is pouring more resources into the war in the skies.

items.title: Gunman kills 6 in rare mass shooting in Poland as 3 family members found dead at suspect’s home
items.brief: At least six people were killed and 16 more wounded after a gunman authorities say holds far-right views opened fire in Kraków, southern Poland, a rare mass shooting that stunned the country.

items.title: 2 skydivers die after colliding midair in California and their parachutes become entangled
items.brief: Two experienced skydivers who were taking part in an organized skydiving event in Southern California were killed after colliding midair and plummeting to the ground.

items.title: New Zealand in political limbo after knife-edge election
items.brief: New Zealand voters face weeks of political limbo after a knife-edge election left the country’s conservative coalition government at risk of losing its majority following just a single term in office.

items.title: 1 killed, 22 injured after impaired driver strikes bicyclists in North Carolina, officials say

items.title: UFC CEO Dana White declines Trump’s offer to become press secretary, source says
items.brief: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he offered the White House press secretary job to Dana White, but a source familiar with the matter says the Ultimate Fighting Championship CEO declined the unorthodox idea.
